firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently ate a honey sandwich goes first.
houseFallback: If nobody qualifies, the timing is tied or unclear, or your group prefers another approach, agree to choose randomly. This is this site’s suggested house rule.
clarifications: Place bees during setup starting with the person to the first player’s right and continuing counterclockwise. The first player places their bee last.
Regular turns then begin with the selected first player and proceed clockwise, through Flight plan, Flying and collecting nectar, and Storing nectar and making honey.
The two-player and expert rules keep this starting-player criterion.

internalEvidence: Complete publisher-hosted or publisher-linked PDF retrieved; relevant setup, opening-turn, variant and edition pages read and visually inspected. Reviewed PDF pages: 1, 2. This publisher-owned Next Move CDN PDF contains two three-panel sheets. Printed page 3 specifies a honey sandwich, not honey alone. Its setup text explicitly runs counterclockwise from the starter’s right, while Gameplay says the selected starter begins clockwise regular turns. Printed page 6 retains all other rules for two-player and expert modes. The large-nectar tie-break applies only to final honey-drop scores. Credits state ©2020. Both full sheets were extracted and visually inspected, including the setup-direction wording.
